### McGraw Hill, Inc. to Participate in Investor Events


August 24, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s205.q4cdn.com/964897494/files/doc_news/McGraw-Hill-Inc--to-Participate-in-Investor-Events-2026.pdf)


COLUMBUS, Ohio--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[McGraw Hill](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.mheducation.com%2F&esheet=54593066&newsitemid=20260824940557&lan=en-US&anchor=McGraw+Hill&index=1&md5=7d7bc2cf3321d3221cc1f54d4eb4c40a) , Inc. (NYSE: MH) today announced the following events:


Philip Moyer, President, Chief Executive Officer and member of the Board of Directors of McGraw Hill, Inc., and Dr. Jason Yeatman, Ph.D., associate professor at Stanford University Graduate School of Education and Department of Psychology, will participate in an investor call hosted by Shlomo Rosenbaum, Managing Director Business & Information Services at Stifel. The call will take place on Wednesday, September 2, 2026, at 2:00 PM ET.


The discussion will focus on the increasing emphasis on Science of Reading-based literacy standards in the United States and McGraw Hill’s recent exclusive integration of ROAR (Rapid Online Assessment of Reading), a dyslexia screener developed at the Stanford University Graduate School of Education, Reading and Dyslexia Research Program. To register, please contact your Stifel representative orshrosenbaum@stifel.com .


Mr. Moyer will attend the Goldman Sachs Communacopia and Technology Conference and participate in a fireside chat on Tuesday, September 8, 2026, at 3:05 PM PT.


The fireside chat will be available via webcast, and a replay will be available on[McGraw Hill, Inc. - Investor Relations](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.mheducation.com%2Foverview%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54593066&newsitemid=20260824940557&lan=en-US&anchor=McGraw+Hill%2C+Inc.+-+Investor+Relations&index=2&md5=8631bb4c06d5be64cbc44e627dc0767b) .


**McGraw Hill**


McGraw Hill (NYSE: MH) is a leading global provider of education solutions for preK-12, higher education and professional learning, supporting the evolving needs of millions of educators and students around the world. We provide trusted, high-quality content and personalized learning experiences that use data, technology and learning science to help students progress towards their goals. Through our commitment to fostering a culture of innovation and belonging, we are dedicated to improving outcomes and access to education for all. We have over 30 offices across North America, Asia, Australia, Europe, the Middle East and South America, and make our learning solutions available in more than 80 languages.
